# YONAH

> YONAH makes the Razor, a flatside crankbait built around a simpler
> approach to crankbait fishing — razor-thin profile, quiet by design,
> a dependable confidence bait for days when you don't know exactly
> what the fish want.

YONAH Baits designs fishing lures for anglers who want gear that just
works. The flagship product is the Razor, a flatside crankbait
launching in 2026.

## Product

- [Razor Crankbait](https://yonahbaits.com/#hero): Flatside crankbait,
  pre-launch 2026. Razor-thin profile for a compact, searching action.
  No rattles, quiet presentation. Built as a confidence bait for
  uncertain conditions.

## Key Features

- Razor-thin profile — an exceptionally thin body for a compact,
  searching action
- Quiet by design — no rattles or unnecessary noise, just a subtle
  presentation
- Confidence bait — dependable performance when it's unclear what
  fish want

## Company

- [Become a Field Tester](https://yonahbaits.com/#testing): Sign up
  to test the Razor before public launch.
- [Contact](https://yonahbaits.com/#contact): Get in touch with YONAH.
